label: Animated Documentary
defn: A non-fiction film told wholly or chiefly through animation: reconstructed memory, testimony or reportage drawn, painted or modelled instead of filmed (Waltz with Bashir, Flee, Ryan, The Sinking of the Lusitania). Live-action documentaries with animated inserts stay in A19.

label: Spokon (Sports-Guts Anime)
defn: The Shōwa-era supōtsu konjō ('sports guts') cycle launched by Ikki Kajiwara's Kyojin no Hoshi: a sports series of brutal training, self-sacrifice and fighting spirit, chiefly 1968–1980s (Kyojin no Hoshi, Attack No.1, Ashita no Joe, Ace wo Nerae!, Tiger Mask). Later sports anime go to their sport (C7).

label: Gender-Bender Anime
defn: A comedy or romance whose engine is a character's change or concealment of sex: magical sex change and body transformation, or crossdressing (josō) passing (Ranma ½, Stop!! Hibari-kun!, Kämpfer, Princess Princess, Oniichan wa Oshimai!). Serious drama of gender identity goes to C8-7; body-swap romance to C5.

label: Soviet Animation
defn: The state-studio animation of the USSR, above all Soyuzmultfilm (Moscow) with Kievnauchfilm, Uzbekfilm and Ekran: fairy-tale features and shorts, satirical and modernist art shorts and the children's classics of its 'Golden Collection' (The Snow Queen, Film, Film, Film, Winnie-the-Pooh, Hedgehog in the Fog, Three from Prostokvashino). Soviet TV serials go to C13-14; Estonian and post-Soviet auteur shorts to C14-5.
